$meta.name: thomasdinatale.com design tokens
$meta.description: Single source of truth for the portfolio's design system. Machine-readable mirror of the CSS custom properties and recurring values in css/styles.css, css/case-study.css, and css/article.css. Values here are the SOURCE OF TRUTH; if the CSS drifts, reconcile.
$meta.canonicalApi: In code, always reference tokens through their CSS custom property (e.g. var(--ember)), never the raw hex. Raw values are listed here only so tools know what each var resolves to per theme.
$meta.themeMechanism: light = :root default. dark = @media(prefers-color-scheme: dark) on :root:not(.theme-light), OR forced via :root.theme-dark. extraDark = :root.theme-extra-dark (the second user-facing theme; the nav circle toggles light <-> extraDark). color-scheme is set to dark for both dark themes.

linen.role: Tinted panel bg (metric, problem, meta, footer, thinking backdrop)

cloud.role: Gradient stroke stop A (start of card border gradient)

metal.role: Gradient stroke stop B (end of card border gradient)

colorNotes.cardBorderGradient: linear-gradient(122deg, var(--cloud) 0%, var(--metal) 100%) — the signature card stroke. Applied via border-box on project-card, article-card, history-card. Pair with linear-gradient(var(--chalk), var(--chalk)) padding-box to keep a chalk fill inside the gradient border.
hardcodedExceptions: Scrim overlays use rgba(0,0,0,0.75) (panel-scrim) — intentional pure black, theme-independent.

brandAccent.$role: Per-project hover fill for homepage .project-card-image. Now CSS vars in styles.css (--accent-*). One-off brand colors, NOT global tokens — only use on the matching project card. primer-app reuses --accent-primer.

typography.axes: Variable WEIGHT (400-900) + italic ONLY. NO width axis.

display.desc: Hero H1 / case-study project name. One per page.
display.note: Weight varies by page: hero 800, .cs-headline 700, .cs2-headline 900. Line-height always 1.

h4CardTitle.desc: Work/writing card title + Notes-on-design headline (H4; the old "h3History" name was wrong — this has always rendered at H4)

h2Problem.desc: Case-study problem-card title + display tagline (semantic H2)

cardTitle.desc: Project / article card titles, section titles, principle names, meta labels

emphasisBody.desc: Semibold callouts, photo captions, CTA buttons, panel/toc titles

body.desc: DEFAULT body text — the workhorse. Use this unless a role above fits.

tag.desc: Tag / metadata pill — the Tag component (see design-system.html → Tag). Same size in every context.

captionSm.desc: Small captions (flow figures, hero image, article images)

eyebrow.letterSpacing: var(--text-eyebrow-ls) = 1.12px (0.96px <=768px on .history-date/.writing-date; .cs2-problem-eyebrow is the lone 1.28px outlier)

space.$base: 8px scale. Common gaps: 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 80. Larger rhythm values used for section padding.

sectionPadding.desktopSection: 80px 160px  (case-study, projects, thinking, about, history use 160px sides; some 0 top)

radius.$role: CSS vars in styles.css: --radius-xs/sm/md/lg/xl. Referenced site-wide — no literal border-radius px remain (except 50% circles and 1px hairlines).

usage.4px: tags (project-tag, history-tag), projects-cta-btn, close buttons, tooltips
usage.16px: image wells (project-card-image, article-image), cs2-metric, cs-evolved, history-card

shadow.$role: CSS vars in styles.css: --shadow-*. Referenced site-wide — no literal box-shadow rgba remain (except the inset ember focus ring on .history-card--link).
shadow.photo: --shadow-photo: 0px 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), 0px 9px 9px rgba(0,0,0,0.09), 0px 21px 13px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0px 38px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.01), 0px 59px 17px rgba(0,0,0,0)  (photo-item; was 'layeredPhoto')
shadow.panel: --shadow-panel: -10px 0 21px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), -39px 0 39px rgba(0,0,0,0.09), -88px 0 53px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), -156px 0 62px rgba(0,0,0,0.01)  (left-facing, case-study slide-out drawer)

motion.fade: 0.5s ease / 0.5s ease-out  (opacity fades, article border reveal, scroll fade-in)

patterns.fadeIn: opacity 0 -> 1, translateY(16px) -> 0 over 0.5s ease-out; .fade-in -> .fade-in.visible (JS adds .visible on scroll)
patterns.linkUnderline: 2px ember bar grows from right edge to full width on hover (width 0 -> 100%, then right:auto/left:0)
